title: rewards.badge_unlocked v1
description: Emitted when the event-driven badge evaluator awards a badge (ADR-001 Block D.3). Source publisher: alebrije-mod-rewards-go, EventPublisher.PublishBadgeUnlocked (internal/service/events_publisher.go:290, event_type stamped at line 291), called from BadgeEvaluator.Evaluate (internal/service/badge_evaluator.go:87). Added 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards, option A2). FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) -- fields are top-level, matching the real producer: cmd/server/main.go:151 wires BadgeEvaluator with the raw Redis-backed EventPublisher (not the outbox-backed one), so publish() (events_publisher.go:295) marshals the Event struct directly onto the 'payload' field of both the bare rewards.badge_unlocked stream and the events:rewards domain mirror. There is no event_version, producer, or data wrapper on this wire shape; occurred_at replaces the envelope's timestamp field. This producer never sets Amount, AccountID, TransactionID, or BalanceAfter -- amount is always 0 on the wire (the Go int64 zero value; the json tag has no omitempty). NOTE (naming): the literal event_type 'rewards.badge_unlocked' is 2-segment (<domain>.<action>), not the 3-segment <domain>.<entity>.<action> ADR-31 pattern envelope.v1.json enforces via regex on event_type -- irrelevant here since this schema does not $ref the envelope, but flagged because the producer cannot be renamed from this lane (see rewards.earned.v1.json / rewards.redeemed.v1.json, which DO $ref the envelope and DO hit this regex).

event_id.description: UUID identifying this event (auto-generated by EventPublisher.publish if the caller left it empty).

event_type.description: Stamped by PublishBadgeUnlocked. Consumers route on this exact value.

transaction_id.description: Not set by this producer (badge unlocks are not ledger transactions).

amount.description: Not applicable -- this producer never sets Amount. Always 0 on the wire.

badge_id.description: Id of the badge that was unlocked.

trigger.description: What triggered the evaluation (e.g. earn, checkin).
